description: This file defines a class JwtTokenGenerator that implements token creation using JWT in an ASP.NET Core application. It generates JWT tokens with claims such as subject, identifier, and issued at time, using specified issuer options.

classes.name: JwtTokenGenerator
classes.description: Generates JSON Web Tokens (JWT) with specified claims for authentication purposes within an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a signed JWT token string for a given username, embedding claims such as subject, token ID, and issued at timestamp.
